text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, I hear a strange mumbling
in the gym.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Deadlift... Dead... It sounds so scary...
But,
well...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez breezed through all of these, so I
can't shy away! All right, let's
start with
200 kilos.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uwaahh! T-Trainer?! Don't scare me like
that! Ugh, and I was just
about to lift some
deads.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's a type of weight training,
don't
you know? They're called
deadlifts.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You pick up a barbell off the ground with
both hands,
then—"Eyah!"—lift it up to
your waist.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And Prez did 200 kilos like they're
nothing. So I've got to give it a try
too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting at the same weight as Symboli
Rudolf would be far too
ambitious. I try to
recommend another exercise for the same
muscle group, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nghh... But I wanna do the same exercises!
Prez chose this, so there's
got to be a
reason.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If I don't do the exact same things in the
exact same way, I'll never
catch up to her.
So I'm gonna give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All right, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Urrrghhhh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I-I did it! Hey, Trainer, did you see that? I can lift the same weight as Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Now to keep this up! I'll
surpass her in no time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uuup, and down. Uuup, and down. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can do it... I can do this! You know,
maybe I can do all the other
exercises she
used to do too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Right, on to the next one! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to warn her,
but it seems all Teio can
hear is the clanging of
weights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Traaaaineeer... Trai— Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nngh... Phew. My body's crying out for
help. Didn't know muscles
could be this
sore...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But hey,
that's proof that they're growing!
The sorer they are, the
bigger they'll get.
Okay, off to the training course!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Owwie ouch ouch ouch! It huuurts! There's
no way I can train like this!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
Maybe I couldn't handle it after all,
doing the same exercises
as Prez...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, you think?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
I did kinda get carried away... Guess
I should've listened to you
more, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sowwy... So, uh, I won't do it again, but
can you do anything about
this soreness?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, the whole day's gonna go to
waste. Please? Pleeease?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do what I can, helping her stretch, and
warming up her muscles.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is this for real? I feel so much
better! Trainer, you've got to be
a genius!
Why'd that work so well?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
They are? Huh. So I might not be as tough
as Prez, but I can spring
back faster at
least. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm all set! Back to training! Ouch,
ouch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat? Even I have my limits, I guess.
Aw, this sucks...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okay, well,
guess I'll just have to rest up
today. Sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But just you wait. One day, I'll be so
strong, I'll be immune to muscle
soreness!
